title: Carve 0.2 HTML import mapping
description: The tables of import-html.md: what an HTML importer makes of each element and attribute that no carrier covers, the Carve render conventions it reads, its diagnostic codes, and what a render without `roundtrip` loses. Every list is sorted by its first field, by code point.

elements.description: Every HTML element the mapping names, and the row `*`.

name.description: The lower-case tag name. `*` is every element with no row.

treatment.description: C2-M-056: `map` gives the node of its clauses; `div` and `span` give that node with the element's attributes; `unwrap` reads the children in place; `raw` gives raw HTML; `drop` gives nothing.

node.description: The node or nodes the element gives. Absent for `unwrap` and `drop`.

note.description: A condition or exception that the clauses state.

clauses.description: The clauses that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

attributes.description: The attribute rows of C2-M-052. The row `*` applies only where no other row matches. Rows that a clause reads for one element are fields of its node (C2-M-053).

name.description: The attribute name, a name prefix, or `*`.

match.description: `name`: the whole name, without ASCII case. `prefix`: a name that starts with it. `reserved`: a reserved name of C2-H-115. `key`: every other name that is a key by C2-I-030.

on.description: The elements the row applies to, or `any`.

treatment.description: What the attribute becomes: `attrs.id`, `attrs.classes`, the node field `lang` or `dir`, a key of `attrs`, a field of the node, nothing (reported), or a carrier read by html.md.

clauses.description: The clauses that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

conventions.description: The render conventions that need no carrier and are read in every input (C2-M-010, C2-M-035).

clauses.description: The clauses that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

codes.description: The diagnostic codes of an importer (C2-M-083).

clauses.description: The clauses that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

losses.description: C2-M-091: the facts a carrier sets, and what a render without it gives back.

comes_back.description: What an import of a render without `roundtrip` gives where this carrier would stand.

clauses.description: The clauses that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
